final:
Created and verified the quick guide in `demo-out/`:

- `guide.md` — numbered steps with relative links to the screenshots
- `01-waiting-orders.png` — waiting-orders table and Send to Sorting button
- `02-sent-to-sorting.png` — success message after sending order A-001
- `REVIEW.md` — visual review notes for both images
- `capture.cjs` and `redact.cjs` — reusable capture script and redaction safety net

The app was driven with Playwright against the live Express app and seeded demo database. The script resets A-001 to `WAITING` before capture so it can be rerun consistently. I used A-001 as the example order; the badges are guide annotations, not app UI. The app server is still running on port 3000.
